provider.name: NCBI Taxonomy
provider.organization_type: global sequence-linked taxonomy, nomenclature, persistent-identifier, lineage, bulk-download, API, command-line, and cross-database infrastructure
provider.description: NCBI Taxonomy is the taxonomic backbone used across NCBI sequence, genome, gene, protein, sample, project, literature, and analysis resources. It provides persistent numeric TaxIDs, scientific and alternate names, ranks, parent-child relationships, complete lineages, divisions, nuclear and organellar genetic codes, merged and deleted identifiers, type-material and host links, bulk taxdump archives, Entrez E-utilities, NCBI Datasets APIs and command-line tools, and cross-database integration.
institutional_context: International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration and global taxonomic authorities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting NCBI Taxonomy documentation, TaxIDs, names, ranks, lineages, genetic codes, divisions, special nodes, type material, host relationships, browser tools, taxdump and new-taxdump files, E-utilities, NCBI Datasets APIs and CLI tools, data models, quality methods, cross-database integration, legal conditions, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: NCBI, NLM, NIH, official Taxonomy Browser records, official FTP snapshots, official E-utilities and Datasets documentation, source publications, INSDC partners, and cited taxonomic authorities remain authoritative for TaxIDs, names, lineages, versions, API behavior, legal conditions, and contact information.
